verdict.oneLiner: Sign-in and posting are self-serve. Almost everything else (marketing, sales, talent) needs partner approval, and compliance access is closed.

approvalWait.note: Open permissions need no approval. Most other permissions and partner programmes require explicit approval from LinkedIn; no timeline is published and approval isn't guaranteed.

prerequisites.label: A LinkedIn developer application
prerequisites.detail: Create or select an app in the LinkedIn Developer Portal.

prerequisites.label: A LinkedIn Page for your company
prerequisites.detail: We believe app creation asks you to associate a LinkedIn Page, but the pages we read don't say so. TODO(human): confirm during app creation.

prerequisites.label: An absolute HTTPS callback URL
prerequisites.detail: Redirect URLs must be absolute HTTPS URLs without '#'. Query parameters are ignored.

steps.title: Create an app in the Developer Portal
steps.body: Create a new application or select an existing one.

steps.title: Add self-serve products
steps.body: Under the Products tab, add Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect (profile, email) and/or Share on LinkedIn (w_member_social).

steps.title: Configure the Auth tab
steps.body: Copy the client ID and secret and add your HTTPS redirect URL. Never send the secret in URLs.

steps.title: Implement the 3-legged flow
steps.body: Send members to https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization, then POST the code to https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken within 30 minutes. Verify state.
steps.agentCanHelp: Writes the authorization and token exchange.

steps.title: Apply for partner programmes if you need them
steps.body: Advertising API is requested from the Products tab; Sales Navigator (SNAP) and Talent integrations have their own applications. Approval is required and may not be granted.

scopes.name: profile
scopes.note: Open permission via Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect.

scopes.name: email
scopes.note: Open permission via Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect.

scopes.name: w_member_social
scopes.note: Open permission: post, comment and like on behalf of the member.

nuances.title: Members must accept every requested scope
nuances.body: Users can't pick individual scopes, so request as few as possible.

nuances.title: Access tokens last 60 days
nuances.body: Programmatic refresh tokens are only available to a limited set of partners; others re-run the flow, which skips the consent screen if the member is still logged in.

nuances.title: Changing scopes invalidates old tokens
nuances.body: Requesting a different scope invalidates all previous access tokens, and changed app scopes require users to re-authenticate.

blockers.title: 401 Invalid scope
blockers.symptom: Authorization fails for a scope you requested.
blockers.fix: The scope's product isn't enabled for your app. Add the product, or apply for the partner programme.

blockers.title: Redirect_uri doesn't match
blockers.fix: Use the exact absolute HTTPS URL configured on the Auth tab.

blockers.title: Partner access not granted
blockers.symptom: Marketing, sales or talent permissions stay unavailable.
blockers.fix: Re-scope to open permissions or work with an approved partner. There is no self-serve path.

humanMust: Create the app and add products
